name: BAYC/Otherside
rootCause: Discord servers for Yuga Lab projects Bored Ape Yacht Club (BAYC) and Otherside appear to have been affected by phishing attacks. The attackers allegedly stole more than 145 ethereum ($256,000) worth of tokens. It appears that the community administrator's account was compromised, which gave attackers access to the administrator account on the server. They then went on to post a link to a phishing site that encouraged users to link their wallets to access "exclusive giveaways." Subsequently, the NFT project BAYC stated on its official Twitter that its Discord server was briefly attacked today, and the team quickly resolved the problem, but some NFTs were still affected.

descriptions.text: Discord servers for Yuga Lab projects Bored Ape Yacht Club (BAYC) and Otherside appear to have been affected by phishing attacks. The attackers allegedly stole more than 145 ethereum ($256,000) worth of tokens. It appears that the community administrator's account was compromised, which gave attackers access to the administrator account on the server. They then went on to post a link to a phishing site that encouraged users to link their wallets to access "exclusive giveaways." Subsequently, the NFT project BAYC stated on its official Twitter that its Discord server was briefly attacked today, and the team quickly resolved the problem, but some NFTs were still affected.

On June 4, 2022, the official BAYC/Otherside Discord was breached via a compromised community manager account. The attacker posted a phishing link, resulting in theft of ETH and high-value NFTs from users, with estimated loss between $250,000 and $370,000. Most stolen funds were sent to Tornado Cash for obfuscation, and no verified recovery occurred. The attacker gained control of a BAYC Discord community manager's account and posted a phishing link in the official channel. Users who followed the message and interacted with the fake minting site had their wallets drained of valuable NFTs and ETH. Trust in official Discord communications enabled the social engineering.
